title: Portuguese Roast Vegan Stew
description: Hearty and comforting stew made with roasted vegetables and portuguese seasonings, perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the portuguese roast, tomato paste, and vegetable broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
